title: ColabShell 2.2.1
release_notes:
- Assistant: the app runs its own local model router — it attaches
  to one already running or embeds its own, so the assistant works
  with no setup
- The thinking stream is visible while the assistant reasons, and a
  Thinking-depth control sets how hard it thinks
- Ask AI about a cell, a file, or terminal output; the assistant can
  create sessions and read them live — even when the session screen
  is not open
- Assistant can create notebook tabs and switch between them, and
  writes starter notebooks without you opening one first
- Terminal AI: follow-up questions in the same dialog, and the whole
  thread continues in the chat with one tap
- Cell AI: Explain and Suggest Next in a two-option menu, and Fix
  Error appears on the output row only when a run actually failed
- Cancel button while the assistant is working — in cells, in the
  terminal dialog, and Stop in chat
- The assistant is no longer cut off mid-task: far more tool rounds
  per reply and a much longer working window
- Credits persist across restarts and reset to the daily cap at
  00:00 UTC; premium days refill to 500, free to 50
- Premium reads at launch: your 500-credit day is correct from
  the first second after an update
- Sessions stay alive while the app is open — a quiet keep-alive
  resets Colab's idle timer well inside its prune window
- Settings rows move their controls under the label on small
  screens, starting with the assistant model picker
- Restore-licence verdicts are honest: a wrong recovery ID says so
  instead of claiming the service is unreachable
- High-RAM shape for new sessions (Colab Pro/Pro+)
- Compute-unit usage card (Settings → Account) with a shared cache
  and truthful errors
- Per-session environment variables (defaults + override; values are
  never logged)
- Multiple notebooks per session, each with isolated saves/exports,
  plus Python script tabs — plain .py files you edit, run, and save
  back to the session
- Command palette (Ctrl+K), Alt+A for the Assistant, Ctrl+I to ask
  about the active cell
- Premium: restore purchases, the recovery ID shown with copy, and
  honest pricing from the licence service
- The header credit pill and the compute chip update the moment the
  numbers change — an assistant credit reward lands instantly, and
  a Settings refresh propagates to the header
- About section rebuilt: contact, rate (Play Store on mobile, GitHub
  on desktop), more apps, live update line
- Stability: splash no longer flashes the home screen mid-boot, the
  bottom navigation stays put on every screen, the FAB switches
  cleanly between the assistant and session options, a boot crash
  right after launch is fixed, and flet 1.1.0 stable throughout
